en.text:
This rocket's tracking capabilities are stronger than other traditional tracking rocket launchers, and have a blast radius of 11 meters.

Dealing damage with 3 rockets without reloading generates <heavy/>1 Ammo. Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with all three rockets grants 'Prototype Trueseeker'.

Prototype Trueseeker grants the following benefits:
• 80% Faster Rate of Fire
• ? Stability
• Significantly improved tracking capabilities
• Rockets now explode into 8 cluster munitions upon detonation, each cluster having a blast radius of 3 meters.
